comments.text:
Created attachment 79183
log when reproducing the bug, wine built with the causing commit

Found the commit that introduced this bug by git bisecting: https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/commit/68c4fa377f20e7c5009d85096df5bb8413cb9e03

Happens on version 4, GNOME 48 Wayland.

1. Start the launcher, then the app, confirm context menus are working
2. Got to gnome-shell overview, then another workspace, then go back to the original workspace
3. Observe the context menus not appearing in CSP, they do appear undearneath the window though, you can shrink the window to see them
comments.creator: ignacykuchcinski@gmail.com

comments.text: I have opened this ticket for version 4, but there is a similar ticket for version 2: https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=58111. However, the author hasn't set the regression SHA1, even after commenting and reaching out to them, so opened this specific for version 4 with the regression SHA1.

comments.creator: izu-3@outlook.com
comments.text: Having this same issue on KDE too; everything is rendered and usable fine if I force the main window to always be underneath everything else, so it just seems to be something causing an ordering issue?

comments.creator: ignacykuchcinski@gmail.com
comments.text:
(In reply to Izu from comment #2)
> Having this same issue on KDE too; everything is rendered and usable fine if
> I force the main window to always be underneath everything else, so it just
> seems to be something causing an ordering issue?

Yes, on GNOME I additionally observe in the reproducing scenario the launcher moving to the top after trying to go back to CSP from another workspace, and the in the overview they flicker black for a second. So it would look like the ordering is almost correct, just upside down.
Since this bug has the same regression sha1, could you try the patch from https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=58505#c8 ?
comments.creator: gijsvrm@gmail.com

(In reply to Gijs Vermeulen from comment #4)
> Since this bug has the same regression sha1, could you try the patch from
> https://bugs.winehq.org/show_bug.cgi?id=58505#c8 ?

Thanks, may I ask how did you find these two bugs to have the same sha1, is there a way to search tickets by their regression sha1?

The bug you linked is definitely related - the initial fix https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/commit/c8422a619b46d25e55907fd5526b1d9fae8c3943 almost solved the problem, although sometimes the menus would only show after a couple of quick presses, but still they would show. After the latest change https://gitlab.winehq.org/wine/wine/-/commit/e4a14b8ce23d69213b7d161ba3f420d0b8b578e5 though, the behaviour reverted to the previous one, which means no menus.
